function.match: Match each organ to what it does.
function.reverse: Which of these organs has this job: {value}?

rows.label: Gallbladder
rows.function: Stores bile that helps digest fat

rows.label: Heart
rows.function: Pumps blood around the body

rows.label: Pancreas
rows.function: Makes digestive juices and insulin

rows.label: Liver
rows.function: Removes toxins from the blood and processes nutrients

rows.label: Spleen
rows.function: Recycles old red blood cells and keeps a reserve of blood

rows.label: Brain
rows.function: Processes thoughts, memory and signals from the senses

rows.label: Thyroid
rows.function: Makes hormones that set how fast the body burns energy

rows.label: Kidney
rows.function: Filters waste out of the blood into urine

rows.label: Esophagus
rows.function: Carries food from the throat to the stomach

rows.label: Pituitary gland
rows.function: Releases hormones that control growth and the body's other hormone makers

rows.label: Eye
rows.function: Detects light so we can see

rows.label: Cerebellum
rows.function: Keeps balance and coordinates movement

rows.label: Thymus
rows.function: Trains the white blood cells called T cells

rows.label: Larynx
rows.function: Produces the voice and guards the windpipe

rows.label: Lung
rows.function: Takes in oxygen and lets out carbon dioxide

rows.label: Tonsil
rows.function: Lymph tissue at the back of the throat that catches germs

rows.label: Adrenal gland
rows.function: Makes stress hormones that ready the body for action

rows.label: Stomach
rows.function: Breaks down food with acid and churning

rows.label: Tongue
rows.function: Tastes food and moves it around for chewing and swallowing

rows.label: Large intestine
rows.function: Absorbs water and holds waste

rows.label: Small intestine
rows.function: Absorbs nutrients from food

rows.label: Skin
rows.function: Covers and protects the body

rows.label: Ear
rows.function: Lets us hear sounds

rows.label: Trachea
rows.function: Carries air down to the lungs

rows.label: Diaphragm
rows.function: Muscle that pulls down to help us breathe in

rows.label: Nose
rows.function: Detects smells and takes in air through two nostrils

rows.label: Bladder
rows.function: Stores urine until we go
